been attending this surgery for years and overall, it is a good surgery, majority of staff are great, I usually always rate the surgery 5 stars, on this occasion I’m rating it not good for people with mental health issues. I took my 21 year old son to the surgery for his 4.30 appointment, we got there for 4.25. At 4.40 I asked receptionist how long it would be before my son got seen, she said the 4pm person had just gone in. I asked to see practice manager, and explained my son who has severe autism and is non verbal, was getting really distressed. I was told there was only one doctor on and that the doctor was a locom. The same thing has happened with the same locom doctor a few months ago, where we waited 45 mins. By the time I took my son in it was nearly 5.10 pm, he was so upset , I just about explained to the doctor , what the problem was. She did apologise. The surgery needs to improve its reasonable adjustment for people with mental Health disabilities.
